content:
sanjay: kicking off Vanguard dedicated slice canary now. pinning model to v1.24.3-2026a; change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. deploybot will post status. @lia @ops-jen please ack KMS overlap and fallback plan.

deploybot: starting canary deploy: slice=vanguard, version=v1.24.3-2026a, instances=3, canary=5%

lia: ack. keeping traffic ramp at 5% for 10m and will watch tail latency.

ops-jen: :warning: KMS rotation window overlaps 02:30-03:15 UTC. If rotation hits we'll see unwrap failures. recommend using fallback key for canary or delay.

kyle: ops-jen noted. can we pin the canary to the old key (proj-vanguard-key-primary) or add fallback? cross-region replicas may already be rotating.

aaron: prepared fallback key. adding proj-vanguard-fallback ARN to the slice config and will attach to canary instances.

deploybot: updated deploy command: `/deploy --slice vanguard --version v1.24.3-2026a --kms-key=proj-vanguard-fallback --canary 5% --canary-duration 10m`

pm-oliver: release notes uploaded (short summary + known issues): KV-cache warmup on long sequences, possible latency bump on first few requests. https://redwood.internal/releases/v1.24.3

lia: canary metrics update (t+1m): latency p95 +8% vs baseline, errors +0.2% absolute. still within our thresholds, continuing.

kyle: baseline error for this tenant ~0.05%. our stop threshold is +0.5% absolute. also watch resident memory; if RSS grows >15% sustained for 5m we roll.

sanjay: agreed. rollback criteria set: (1) error rate increase >0.5% absolute, (2) p95 latency +30% absolute, (3) memory +15% sustained 5m. trigger auto-rollback + page on-call and open incident if any hit.

deploybot: canary in progress: 1/3 instances healthy, 2/3 warming. will report at canary end (10m) or on threshold breach.

lia: t+6m update: errors creeping to +0.6% now, concentrated on POST /api/chat with long context windows. logs show repeated kv-cache misses and some model OOMs on worst cases :eyes:.

kyle: that's beyond threshold (>0.5%). proceeding to rollback. @deploybot start rollback to v1.24.2 and restore kms to proj-vanguard-key-primary.

deploybot: initiating rollback: target=v1.24.2, kms-key=proj-vanguard-key-primary. ETA ~3m. audit note attached.

ops-jen: KMS rotation still running; watch for transient unwrap errors during the change. if we see >5% transient 5xxs, escalate immediately.

deploybot: rollback complete. all instances back to v1.24.2. health checks green. audit id: 20260321-4450019876-rollback

sanjay: thanks everyone. opening follow-up and a short postmortem. action item: block canaries during overlapping KMS rotations and add fallback key by default for tenant canaries. @pm-oliver add note to release notes and customer comms.

pm-oliver: noted. scheduling a re-run for 04:30 UTC after rotation ends and adding a blurb to the release notes and tenant notification.

Code snippets for ops notes (pasted to runbook):
```
# rollback command run by deploybot
/deploy --slice vanguard --rollback-to v1.24.2 --kms-key proj-vanguard-key-primary
```

```
# canary config to prefer fallback during rotations
canary:
  traffic: 0.05
  duration: 10m
  kms_preference: [proj-vanguard-fallback, proj-vanguard-key-primary]
```

sanjay: will follow up with a short incident doc and assign owners for prevention. thanks :thumbsup:
